Hi all —

Thanks Vanessa. Quick details from Product Security and Evidence team to answer Derek's bullets:

1) Default retained log classes (180 days):
- Authentication events (auth success/failure)
- Administrative actions (role changes, ACL edits)
- Tenant request traces (API request/response headers, error stacks; model input/metadata stripped per PII policy)
- Inference telemetry: model_id, latency, token counts (not full prompt content unless customer opts in)

2) Preservation packages:
- We generate time-bounded preservation bundles as gzipped tarballs stored in a secured S3 bucket under encrypted prefixes: s3://redwood-preserve/bluecrest/<YYYYMMDD>-bundle.tar.gz
- Each bundle contains: manifest.csv (entry, prefix, size, sha256), retention-policy.txt (excerpt), basic index.json (redacted).
- For audits we can provide a single sample bundle covering a configurable window (we typically do 14-day sample bundles for SOC evidence).

3) Customer-specific 90-day exception (tenant-scoped):
- Allowed in product as a formal exception. Requirements: written request from the customer PO + signed exception attestation by Redwood InfoSec.
- Exception mechanics: ephemeral debug buckets are configured with lifecycle rules to delete after 90 days; audit-grade indexes and manifests are preserved per the exception record and included in preservation bundles (so we can demonstrate the scope/limits).
- Documentation: we provide a signed attestation PDF that states the scope, start/end dates, and technical controls (bucket lifecycle, manifest sampling). We can also add an addendum to the customer contract if Legal requires it.

Deliverables we can produce for BlueCrest by Nov 10 (deadline accommodated):
- One redacted preservation bundle (14-day window) with manifest + checksums.
- Attestation draft (PDF) ready for review; option to sign via DocuSign.
- A short control narrative mapping SIG/CAIQ controls to the preservation artifacts.

Attachments I'm adding to this thread: retention-policy-excerpt-2026.pdf; sample-manifest-example.csv (redacted).

If BlueCrest wants the formal 90-day exception executed, please have your PO email exceptions@redwoodinference.com and note the tenant ID and requested window. We'll track via JIRA (SEC-7421) and produce the attestation within 3 business days after approval.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Security Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
